pli-tv-bu-vb-ss2:3.1.48: dukkaṭassa → ito paraṃ yu. ma. potthakesu ekamūlakanti dissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss2:3.3.60: dukkaṭānaṃ → ito paraṃ yu. ma. potthakesu dumūlakanti dissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss2:3.4.29: parāmasati → yu. potthake ayaṃ pāṭho na dissati. evaṃ sabbasmiṃ īdise ṭhāne daṭṭhabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss2:3.7.11: bhaginī → yu. ma. mātā dhītā bhaginī ca.
